about: Inputs and expected products of the finalize stage's fixture (make stage-finalize; rapidpipe selftest --stage finalize). The inputs are a synthetic difference attempt written by rapidpipe.selftest.support.fakefinalize.build_difference_output; see tests/fixtures/finalize/README.md. Values that depend on the invocation (RPRUN, RPATTMPT, RPINST, RPOUTLOC, DATE) are checked against the manifest and the outputs directory, not fixed here.
